cohort: A total of 524 pregnant women were enrolled, comprising 174 women with ultrasonographically confirmed uterine fibroids and 350 women without fibroids serving as controls.
finding: Uterine fibroids significantly increase the risk of adverse pregnancy and delivery outcomes, with fibroid size and location being important determinants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were markedly elevated in the fibroid group (52.3%) compared to controls (28.6%).
birth_weight: 2.78+/-0.52 kg in neonates born to women with fibroids vs. 3.14+/-0.46 kg in controls
